title: eCPA Flash: Phase stability and flash calculations for CO2 + H2O + NaCl mixtures with the electrolyte Cubic-Plus-Association equation of state
description: Open-source Python package for phase-stability and two-phase flash (phase-split) calculations in mixtures of carbon dioxide, water, and sodium chloride, using the electrolyte Cubic-Plus-Association (eCPA) equation of state. A hierarchical algorithm couples Michelsen tangent-plane-distance stability analysis with accelerated successive substitution and Newton inner solvers, achieving 100% flash convergence across more than 9,800 two-phase conditions spanning T = 0-425 °C and P = 1-1500 bar at salinities from fresh water to 6 mol/kg NaCl. The repository includes the complete eCPA implementation, a salt-free CPA flash, precomputed warm-start solution tables, the full experimental validation database, a prototype reservoir simulator, and executable notebooks that reproduce every figure of the companion journal article (Industrial & Engineering Chemistry Research, in press, doi:10.1021/acs.iecr.6c02626).
